chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAbd al-Aʿlā, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “There was never any Prophet who came except with recognition of our right and our superiority over those besides us.”

key_terms.تَفْضِيلِنَا: our being given superiority and precedence
key_terms.حَقِّنَا: our rightful claim and due right

ai.seo_question: Did all Prophets come with recognition of the right and superiority of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that all Prophets came bearing recognition of the right of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and their superiority over others. It presents this recognition as part of the divinely conveyed truth associated with prophethood and wilayah.
